# gcore_cloud_registry_repositories (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcore_cloud_registry_repositories" "example_cloud_registry_repositories" {
  project_id = 0
  region_id = 0
  registry_id = 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `registry_id` (Number)

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000
- `project_id` (Number)
- `region_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `artifact_count` (Number) Number of artifacts in the repository
- `created_at` (String) Repository creation date-time
- `id` (Number) Repository ID
- `name` (String) Repository name
- `pull_count` (Number) Number of pools from the repository
- `registry_id` (Number) Repository registry ID
- `updated_at` (String) Repository modification date-time
